tech_constraints: Rust core (docx_engine) must compile as a library without GUI dependencies
quick-xml for XML streaming; no regex-based document.xml mutation
SQLite via rusqlite (bundled); no network database
Zero-knowledge licensing/telemetry: document contents never transmitted
Deterministic generation only: no LLM/AI in the document generation path
Strict CSP required in Tauri config
Offline-first: core features must function without internet
